description: This file contains middleware setup and authentication logic for an Express.js server, including JWT and session management, login, token refresh, and SSO handling.

methods.name: initializeJwtCookieMiddleware
methods.description: Initializes passport middleware, JWT strategy, login, token refresh, and SSO handling for an Express app.

methods.name: verifyToken
methods.description: Middleware to verify JWT token validity and license status, attaching user info to request.

methods.name: verifyTokenForBullMQDashboard
methods.description: Middleware for JWT verification specific to BullMQ dashboard, with redirects on failure.

methods.name: setTokenOrCookies
methods.description: Sets JWT tokens as cookies or redirects for SSO login.

methods.name: generateJwtAuthToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT auth token for a user, considering SSO token expiry.

methods.name: generateJwtRefreshToken
methods.description: Generates a refresh JWT token for a user, considering SSO refresh token expiry.
